_provenance.note: tgId 1, tcId 3, the group's largest macLen case (160 bits / 20 bytes). Independently re-verified against Node's crypto (OpenSSL) oracle before use. Replaces a self-generated (Node-oracle) vector — WS-7 of the 2026-08-28 continuation plan. NIST's ACVP-HMAC reference set deliberately covers SP 800-107 truncation lengths (80-160 bits in this sample; no full-256-bit case exists in the reference/demo set), so the wiring now uses CKM_SHA256_HMAC_GENERAL (hsm_hmacVerifyGeneral) instead of the exact-length-only CKM_SHA256_HMAC, to test the mechanism the vector is actually for.
